verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v1: llāhumma ṣalli wasallim ʿalā nabiyyi ʾatā bil-hudā wal-karam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v2: ṣalāta tadūmu watabqā ʾilā qiyāmi l-ʾanāmi waḥashri l-ʾumam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v3: ʾidhā shiʾita rafʿa l-balā wan-niqam wadafʿa l-kurūbi wajalba n-niʿam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v4: faqul bilisāni faṣīḥi ʾatam rafaʿtu ʾumūrī libārī n-nasam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v5: faqul yā ʾilahī wayā khāliqī wayā khāliqa l-khalqi yā rāziqī
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v6: ʿalīmu biman yaʿṣī ʾaw yattaqī wamūjidunā baʿda sabqi l-ʿadam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v7: mumītu l-khalāʾiqi baʿda l-ḥayāt wamunshī l-ʿiẓāmi wamuḥyī r-rimam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v8: wajāmiʿunā fī bisāṭi n-nushūr wasāʾilunā yawma ḥashri l-ʾumam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v9: mudhillu l-ʿazīzi muʿizzu dh-dhalīl malīku l-mulūki wamūlī n-niʿam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v10: ʿalayhi ʿtamadtu ʾilayhi stanadtu biẓahrī lajaʾatu ʾilā muʿtaṣam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v11: wafawwaḍtu ʾamrī ʾilayhi faqad jarā l-ḥukmu qidmā wakhaṭṭa l-qalam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v12: famā shāʾa kāna wamā lam yashaʾa famumtaniʿu kayfa shāʾa ḥtakam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v13: wayafʿalu fī mulkihi mā yashā taʿālā l-ʾilahu wajalla l-ḥakam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v14: famā ʾin yuqālu limādhā faʿal walim lā wahal lā bihadhā ḥtakam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v15: walaw ʾanna kulla l-warā ʾajmaʿū ʿalā maṭlabi dūnahu mā statam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v16: famā khāba ʿabdu ʿalayka ttakal walā ḍāʿa ʿabdu ḥimāhu t-tazam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v17: ʾamawlāyā hab liyā ṣabrā ʿalā kurūbi tawālat waḍurri ʾalam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v18: ʾanilniyā fīhā r-riḍā bil-qaḍā waṣabrā jamīlā jazīla l-qisam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v19: faman ʿanhu yawmā raḍīta faqad ʾaṣāba r-riḍā wath-thawāba ghtanam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v20: biʿaynika mā nālanī min hawān wadhulli wamā massanī min saqam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v21: waʾanta l-ʿalīmu biman kādanī bisūʾi waminnī shtafā wāntaqam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v22: waʾanta l-qadīru ʿalayhim waʾanta tujīru lladhī biḥimāka ʿtaṣam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v23: waʾinnī kathīru l-khaṭā wadh-dhunūbu wakhawfī mimmā ʿalayyā rtasam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v24: waqad jāʾa ʾanna l-balā wal-miḥan yunīlāni faḍla th-thawābi l-ʾaʿam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v25: waʾannahumā yamḥuwāni dh-dhunūb waʾannahumā yujzilāni l-qisam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v26: tawālat dhunūbu waʿammat khuṭūb wadāmat kurūbu wazāda l-ʾalam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v27: fayā mālika l-mulki yā ʿuddatī wakāshifa mā ḥalla bī min niqam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v28: tadārak ʿubaydā ʿaẓīma dh-dhunūb biʿafwika rabbī ʿammā jtaram
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v29: wakhudh biyadī ʾinnanī ghāriqu wamā ʾanā ʾaqraʿu mina n-nadam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v30: faʾin lam takun ʾākhidhā biyadī waʾillā fayā zallaha lil-qadam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v31: faʾin lam tahab lī minka r-riḍā wataʿfū ʿannī famā lī qadam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v32: faman lil-kurūbi waman l-khuṭūb waman lidh-dhunūbi wamā qad ʾaham
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v34: faqad khāba fīman siwāka l-ʾamal waḥablu rajāʾī siwāka nfaṣam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v35: walam yabqa ʾillā ʿalayka ʿtimādī wamā lī siwā bābikum multazam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v36: saʾaltuka yā khāliqī ḍāriʿā biqalbi salīmi wanahji ʾamam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v37: bishayʾi walā shayʾa ʾaʿẓamu minka ʿalayka ʾayā dhā l-ʿulā wal-karam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v38: bimā qad daʿāka bihi ʾādamu wanūḥu fāʾāba binayli l-ʿiṣam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v39: kadhāka l-khalīlu wathumma dh-dhabīḥ wahūdu walūṭu hudātu l-ʾumam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v40: wayūsufu ʾayḍā bimā qad daʿāk wayaʿqūbu fī shamlihi fāntaẓam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v41: waʾayyūbu ʾidh massahu ḍurruhu wadhū n-nūni ḥīna ghadā multaqam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v42: wamūsā l-kalīmu fanajjaytahu waʾaghraqta ʾaʿdāʾahu wasṭa yam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v43: warūḥuka ʿīsā fakhallaṣtahu waʾaskantahu fī maḥalli n-niʿam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v44: bidaʿwati khayri l-warā kullihim mina l-ʿurbi ʾajmaʿihim wal-ʿajam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v45: biḥḥaqi ʿulāhu biḥḥaqi bahāhu binūri sanāhu mujallī ẓ-ẓulam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v46: muḥammadi ṭ-ṭāhiri l-mujtabā shafīʿi l-khalāʾiqi fī l-muzdaḥam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v47: biḥḥaqi l-qurʾāni wāʾāyātihi wamā fīhi mustawdaʿu min ḥikam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v48: biṭaha wayas maʿ kāfihā biḥurmahi qāfi wanūni wal-qalam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v49: bimā jāʾa min ʾaḥrufi ʾūdiʿat laṭāʾifa qad ʾukkidat bil-qasam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v50: biḥurmahi makkaha ʾummi l-qurā waḥurmahi kaʿbatihā wal-ḥaram
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v51: wamā thamma min mashʿari mushʿiri bitaʿẓīmi qadri biṭūli l-qidam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v52: biturbahi khayri l-warā ʾaḥmadi wāʾālihi man fī dhawīhi ntaẓam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v53: biḥḥaqi ṣ-ṣaḥābati wat-tābiʿīna waʾahli l-ʿulūmi waʾahli l-ḥikam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v54: wabīlʾawliyāʾi jamīʿā waman bakā khawfa dhanbi lahu wanadam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v55: bihadhā l-waliyyī ʾabī madyani ʾimāmi l-mashāʾikhi rāʿī dh-dhimam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v56: washaykhi sh-shayūkhi lladhīna maḍā waqudwatihim fī ṭ-ṭarīqi l-ʾamam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v57: waqidmā khadamtu ḍarīḥā lahu faʾubʿidtu ʿanhu bidhanbi ʾalam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v58: kamā ʾabʿadatnī dhunūbiyā ʿan jiwāri n-nabiyyī wasuknā l-ḥaram
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v59: famuʿẓamu ʿumrī maḍā ḍāʾiʿā wakam min dhunūbi janaytu wakam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v60: wanāhaztu khamsīna lam ʾattaʿiẓ walam t-tafit limaʿālī l-himam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v61: fayā ʾarḥama r-rāḥimīna wayā karīmā yuḥḥibu s-sakhā wal-karam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v62: takarram ʿalayyā wajud bir-riḍā wayassir khalāṣiyā mimmā ʾaham
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v63: wathumma ṣ-ṣalātu ʿalā l-muṣṭafā shafīʿi l-khalāʾiqi fī l-muzdaḥam
verses.autre-idha-shita-rafal-bala-c1-v33: siwāka tujallī watunjī mina l-humūmi biʾajmaʿihā was-saqam
